run_passive_forces: run the passive function to compute all passive forces including springs, dampers, gravity compensation, and fluid forces
compute_spring_damper_forces: compute spring and damper passive forces for dof joints with free, ball, hinge, and slide joint types
compute_tendon_passive_forces: compute spring and damper passive forces for tendons using Jacobian mapping to joint torques
compute_fluid_forces: compute body-space fluid forces for both inertia-box and ellipsoid fluid interaction models
compute_flex_elasticity_forces: compute elasticity and bending forces for flexible bodies using edge-based spring models
